hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,subprocess,os; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); (f.endswith('.py') and os.path.exists(f)) and (subprocess.run(['ruff','check','--fix',f],capture_output=True), subprocess.run(['ruff','format',f],capture_output=True))" 2>/dev/null; true
